title: Pack v2 shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by the pack v2 file schemas only. Harness-wide shapes are referenced from schemas/common/ and schemas/pack/defs.json, not redefined.

label.description: A label on a pack item: '<name>' or '<namespace>:<name>', lowercase. Classification is by label, never by a domain enum. The 'sys:' namespace is reserved for labels that change SDK behavior; only the listed ones exist. 'topic:<topic id>' labels are derived from the topic tree. Any other label must be declared in the pack's labels file (checked by the Importer).

vocabulary_label.description: A label the pack declares. The reserved 'sys:' and derived 'topic:' namespaces cannot be declared.
